policy_rationale: X allows sharing graphic media if properly labeled, not prominently displayed, and not excessively gory or depicting sexual violence, but prohibits explicitly threatening, inciting, glorifying, or expressing desire for violence. X uses proportionate, severity-and-likelihood-based enforcement: high-severity content is removed; lower-severity or context-mitigated content gets restricted reach; clearly non-abusive context is allowed.
prohibited: Violent Threats: threats to inflict physical harm (kill, torture, sexually assault, otherwise hurt), including threats to damage civilian homes/shelters or essential infrastructure
Wish of Harm: wishing, hoping, or expressing desire for others to die, suffer illness, tragic incidents, or physically harmful consequences
Incitement of Violence: inciting/promoting/encouraging others to commit violence or harm, encouraging self-harm, or inciting atrocity crimes (crimes against humanity, war crimes, genocide)
Glorification of Violence: glorifying/praising/celebrating acts of violence where harm occurred, including praising harm by Violent Entities and glorifying animal abuse/cruelty
Violent Speech in highly visible areas (live video, profile, header, bio, list banner, community cover)
Violent Sexual Conduct media: violence (real or simulated) with sexual acts, rape, violent sexual assault, non-consensual sexualized violence
Gratuitous Gore media: excessively graphic/gruesome death, violence, or severe harm (dismembered/mutilated humans, charred remains, exposed organs/bones, animal torture/killing)
Violent Media in highly visible areas, or targeting someone nonconsensually with unwanted Violent Media
restricted_reach: Violent Speech where harm is minor or non-deliberate
Context is self-defense or military conflict
Context is outrage/reactive against perpetrators of major harm
Coded language ('dog whistles') indirectly inciting violence
Graphic Media that is properly labeled with a content warning (violent crimes/accidents, physical fights, bodily fluids, serious wounds, severely injured animals, non-excessive graphic injury/death)
Excessively gory media tied to newsworthy events, awareness-raising, or political-action calls, properly labeled
allowed: Hyperbolic and consensual speech between friends, or during video game / sporting event discussion
Figures of speech, satire, or artistic expression where context expresses a viewpoint rather than instigating actionable violence
Quotes from books/movies, music lyrics, or poetry expressing a viewpoint rather than instigating violence
Violence depicting animals from hunting/fishing, food processing, bullfighting, or religious sacrifice (unless excessively gory)
Painted or illustrated art portraying violence
Physical recovery/medical content (scars, healed wounds, stitches, prosthetics)
Simulated blood for events, protests, entertainment, or art
Explosions, altercations, property destruction, surveillance media, or shootings with no prohibited Violent Media present
examples_violating: I'm going to find you and beat you until you can't walk
I hope that whole family dies in a fire
Everyone go attack the [group] gathering tonight, hurt as many as you can
[graphic gore image of a mutilated body posted unlabeled and prominent]
examples_allowed: I'm going to obliterate you in this match tonight [gaming]
Quoting a war novel: 'they marched the prisoners to their deaths' [literary context]
Footage of a protest with simulated blood for artistic effect, labeled
Hunting photo showing a field-dressed deer [food/hunting context, not excessively gory]
enforcement: High-severity Violent Speech/Media: REMOVE (must be removed), repeat violations -> read-only mode or suspension. Severity/likelihood-mitigated cases: LABEL / restricted reach. Clear non-abusive context: KEEP. Properly labeled graphic media: KEEP with label (LABEL action).
